question.text: The lock of a safe consists of five discs each of which features the digits <math> <mrow> <mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext> </mtext><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext> </mtext><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>....</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>9.</mn></mrow> </math> The safe can be opened by dialing a special combination of the digits. If the work day lasts <math> <mrow> <mn>13</mn></mrow> </math> hours and to dial one combination of digits takes <math> <mn>5</mn> </math> seconds, then number of days sufficient enough to open the safe, are

solution.text:
Total time required=(total number of dials required to sure open the lock)×5s

=105×5s

=50000060×60×13days=10.7 days

Hence, 11 days are enough to open the safe.
